#!/usr/bin/env bash
# background_tasks.sh
# Run a small set of safe background maintenance/reporting tasks concurrently.
# Output is written to /tmp/background_tasks.log.

set -Eeuo pipefail

LOG_FILE="${LOG_FILE:-/tmp/background_tasks.log}"
LOCK_FILE="${LOCK_FILE:-/tmp/background_tasks.lock}"

log() {
  printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" "$*" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

run_task() {
  local name="$1"
  shift
  (
    log "START $name"
    if "$@" >>"$LOG_FILE" 2>&1; then
      log "DONE  $name"
    else
      local rc=$?
      log "FAIL  $name exit=$rc"
      exit "$rc"
    fi
  ) &
  pids+=("$!")
}

collect_system_snapshot() {
  echo "--- hostname ---"
  hostname || true
  echo "--- uptime ---"
  uptime || true
  echo "--- disk usage ---"
  df -h / /tmp 2>/dev/null || df -h
  echo "--- memory ---"
  free -h 2>/dev/null || vm_stat 2>/dev/null || true
}

archive_tmp_listing() {
  local out="/tmp/tmp-listing-$(date -u '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ').txt"
  find /tmp -maxdepth 2 -mindepth 1 -print 2>/dev/null | sort > "$out"
  echo "Wrote $out"
}

simulate_report_generation() {
  # Placeholder for a longer-running background job.
  sleep 2
  echo "Generated report at $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
}

main() {
  exec 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
  if ! flock -n 9; then
    echo "Another instance is already running: $LOCK_FILE" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  : > "$LOG_FILE"
  log "Background task runner starting"

  pids=()
  run_task "system-snapshot" collect_system_snapshot
  run_task "tmp-listing" archive_tmp_listing
  run_task "report-generation" simulate_report_generation

  failures=0
  for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do
    if ! wait "$pid"; then
      failures=$((failures + 1))
    fi
  done

  if (( failures > 0 )); then
    log "Completed with $failures failed task(s)"
    exit 1
  fi

  log "All background tasks completed successfully"
}

main "$@"
